title: 回滚判定器：按窗口错误率（permille 整数）与 P95 延迟判据，连续 2 个窗口越界才回滚（正反两组）
expected_output:

  window0 requests=1200  ok                       error_permille=10   p95_ms=210
  window1 requests=1300  ok                       error_permille=11   p95_ms=205
  window2 requests=1250  ok                       error_permille=8    p95_ms=199
  rollback=False
=== single_spike_then_ok ===
  window0 requests=1400  breach                   error_permille=150  p95_ms=240
  window1 requests=1300  ok                       error_permille=8    p95_ms=205
  window2 requests=1280  ok                       error_permille=7    p95_ms=201

  window0 requests=1500  breach                   error_permille=80   p95_ms=260
  window1 requests=1400  breach                   error_permille=114  p95_ms=900

code:
RULES = {"min_requests": 200, "error_permille_max": 50, "p95_ms_max": 800, "consecutive_windows": 2}

SCENARIOS = {
    "healthy_steady": [(1200, 12, 210), (1300, 15, 205), (1250, 10, 199)],
    "single_spike_then_ok": [(1400, 210, 240), (1300, 11, 205), (1280, 9, 201)],
    "sustained_degradation": [(1500, 120, 260), (1400, 160, 900), (1350, 140, 310)],
    "insufficient_data": [(40, 20, 300), (30, 22, 320)],
}


def permille(errors, requests):
    return errors * 1000 // requests


def decide(windows):
    breaches, decisions, consec = [], [], 0
    for i, (req, err, p95) in enumerate(windows):
        if req < RULES["min_requests"]:
            decisions.append((i, "skip_insufficient_data", 0, p95))
            continue
        pm = permille(err, req)
        breach = pm > RULES["error_permille_max"] or p95 > RULES["p95_ms_max"]
        if breach:
            consec += 1
        else:
            consec = 0
        decisions.append((i, "breach" if breach else "ok", pm, p95))
        if consec >= RULES["consecutive_windows"]:
            return True, i, decisions
    return False, None, decisions


for label, windows in SCENARIOS.items():
    rollback, at, decisions = decide(windows)
    print("=== %s ===" % label)
    for i, verdict, pm, p95 in decisions:
        print("  window%d requests=%-5d %-24s error_permille=%-4d p95_ms=%d"
              % (i, windows[i][0], verdict, pm, p95))
    print("  rollback=%s" % rollback)
    if rollback:
        print("  rollback_at_window=%d" % at)

print("=== judgement ===")
print("thresholds=%s" % ",".join("%s=%s" % (k, RULES[k]) for k in sorted(RULES)))
r1, _, _ = decide(SCENARIOS["healthy_steady"])
r2, _, _ = decide(SCENARIOS["single_spike_then_ok"])
r3, _, _ = decide(SCENARIOS["sustained_degradation"])
r4, _, _ = decide(SCENARIOS["insufficient_data"])
print("healthy_no_rollback=%s" % (r1 is False))
print("single_spike_no_rollback=%s" % (r2 is False))
print("sustained_breach_rollback=%s" % (r3 is True))
print("insufficient_data_no_rollback=%s" % (r4 is False))
